Where you\'re standing now becomes your home. The home button brings the map straight back to it; holding the button for three seconds clears it again.

Step back into the dashed circle around your start and close the loop. Everything inside becomes yours. A loop over older claims is drawn on top of them, and every claim keeps all of its ground.
Under your own power only. Enclose watches how you\'re moving — vehicle trips aren\'t recorded, and driving a loop won\'t claim it.
